method: Project polygons to UTM 18N, erode each by 1.1 m placement uncertainty, then compute the maximum inscribed-circle diameter. A fully contained 20 m square necessarily contains a 10 m-radius circle, so a safe polygon with maximum inscribed-circle diameter below 20 m cannot support one clean 20 m analysis footprint.
reason_query_not_executed: The geometry gate failed first. Querying acquisitions or backscatter cannot repair the absence of a clean 20 m footprint.
next_step: Redesign larger shallow and deep polygons from the Phase 3 survey, then repeat the pixel-support gate before any Sentinel-1 query.
